collection.description: A healer wonders whether a failing organ could be replaced in a gravely ill adult.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After observing tissue survive briefly between animals, a healer wonders whether a failing organ could be replaced in a gravely ill adult. No villager knows how to prevent rejection or infection.

choices.label: Offer the patient a carefully explained experimental operation.
Study the animal findings before attempting human surgery.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient consents; the operation briefly improves their strength, but a later fever threatens their life.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient consents, but the transplanted organ fails and the healer records the loss.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient lives several more peaceful weeks with family.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patient unexpectedly stabilizes, leaving the healer unsure why.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The healer discovers that early survival did not mean lasting success.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The research yields a useful wound-care insight but no safe transplant.
